title: The Marmite Affair: A Flatshare Opera

cast.name: Jess
cast.role: Keeper of the Sacred Oat Milk

scenes.title: Act I: The Sink of Sorrows

lines.lyric: Seven days the dishes stood, a leaning tower of shame!
They were soaking! It's a method! You can't prove I'm to blame!
lines.direction: clutching a tea towel like a shield

lines.lyric: Soaking? There is mould that has begun to pay rent here.
Friends, please! Let us breathe, let us talk, let us calmly share a beer.
There's a rota on the fridge, and the fridge is never wrong!
Your rota is a tyrant, and I'll not sing its song!
Who has touched my oat milk? Who has dared to break the seal?
I may have had a splash. It was for a single meal.
lines.direction: hiding a mug behind his back

lines.lyric: I was only here for the Wi-Fi password, honest, I swear.
Is that Marmite on the ceiling? How? And why? And WHERE?
A catapult of toast, my dear. An accident of art.
Then you will clean it, Marcus, with your own toothbrush for a start.
Is it rude to ask if anyone is using that last bit of toast?

scenes.title: Act III: The Group Chat Reconciliation

lines.lyric: Let us write it in the chat, the rota, kind and fair!
lines.direction: raising his phone like a torch

lines.lyric: I will scrub the pans till dawn, and I'll do it with some flair.
And I shall buy more oat milk, enough for all to share!
Then the rota is amended, with a heart emoji there.
I'll bring the biscuits Thursday, if I'm welcome in your hall.
Five stars for peace in Flat Four! Mute notifications, one and all!
